pr.body:
Existing unannotated text records can now receive a model-assisted classification proposal using an author-defined, frozen list of exact labels. The model must choose one offered label or explicitly abstain; unknown or malformed labels fail without fallback. Explicit Apply atomically saves one draft target and its idempotent evidence receipt, preserves acquisition provenance, and never grants human review.

The attempt freezes source, prompt, provider/model, labels and revisions. Cancellation/restart handling, projected summary polling and editor ownership reuse the proposal lifecycle. Exact admission ID/body is durably stored before POST and restored synchronously after reload; Web Locks coordinate pages. Ambiguous 404s/lost acknowledgements preserve identity, changed intent is refused, and visible author controls support explicit identical-ID retry without automatic inference.

Validation: all 46 aggregate gates and 271 Python tests passed on runtime commit c5500cba5021949bccf45d2124ee5e2910dc5c92. Independent backend/recovery review passed 18 probes; interaction review passed storage/locking, 11 composed ownership probes, native reload and actual two-page fencing. The published head adds only evidence/documentation. Previously blocked instruction consumers now pass in an isolated pinned CPU environment; all 1,457 prior evidence files remain byte-identical. [Exact evidence](docs/plans/text-classification-proposals/reports/recovery-persistence/verification.md).

Started at requested PR #17 head 07ec464ba050cd532a2508ce86570a1ce9bcd394 and stacked on its branch. PR #17's author independently advanced that branch to 4ed5466fd764e938999cca1d535e9a33379271a0; static/workbench.html currently conflicts. Resolve and requalify the integrated classification candidate before merge. This PR makes no writes to PR #17, frozen main or image-caption development.

All inference fixtures use bounded synthetic HTTP. Real-provider compatibility and semantic quality remain unqualified. Available origin storage and Web Locks are required; failures and corrupt pending evidence fail closed. Draft publication only; no merge or CodeRabbit request.
pr.title: Propose exact-label text classifications with explicit abstention
